turns.content: Describe the Earth-to-Mars Hohmann transfer ellipse and explain why the one-way flight time is half of its orbital period.
Using r_E=1.50e11 m and r_M=2.28e11 m, calculate the characteristic geometric quantity required by the trajectory described above.
Using M_sun=6.67e-11 in SI units and M_sun=1.99e30 kg, calculate the solar gravitational parameter and write the half-period formula.
Evaluate the resulting quantity in the units established above, using the stated Mars-Sun radius consistently.
What idealizations underlie the estimate obtained above, and to how many significant figures should the result be reported?
Report the final value in the units used above and include a brief derivation.
